categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the development, construction, sale, and leasing of residential buildings, commercial office buildings, and industrial factory buildings. It also undertakes industrial park development and leasing, garden landscaping, and interior decoration design and construction. The business focuses on residential, office, and industrial real estate sectors within Taiwan.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced construction methods including aluminum formwork, integrated bathroom systems, and industrialized interior decoration to improve efficiency and reduce waste. It integrates green building technologies, smart building systems, and LEED certification principles to meet sustainability goals. Project management information systems (PMIS) are used for standardized, transparent, and efficient project execution and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are individual homebuyers for residential properties and corporate clients for industrial and commercial office buildings. The company serves the housing market, industrial tenants, and enterprises requiring smart factory and office spaces, especially in technology and manufacturing sectors. It also collaborates with government agencies on urban renewal projects.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Taiwan, with strategic land development and project execution focused on the Taipei metropolitan area (including New Taipei and Keelung), Tainan, and Kaohsiung. The company actively participates in urban renewal and industrial park developments in northern and southern Taiwan regions.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, focusing on land acquisition, property development, construction management, and direct sales or leasing to end-users. It collaborates with upstream suppliers such as construction material providers and contractors but does not engage in raw material production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include diversifying land development through urban renewal, joint development, and public urban renewal projects. The company emphasizes sustainable development by integrating green building, smart building technologies, and near-zero carbon construction. It invests in digital transformation for project and customer management and focuses on enhancing product quality and brand competitiveness through innovation in design and construction methods.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of completed residential and commercial properties, pre-sale of housing projects, and leasing of industrial and office buildings. The company also earns income from joint development projects and urban renewal collaborations. There is no indication of subscription or licensing revenue streams.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in Taiwan's real estate development sector, particularly in residential, commercial, and industrial property markets. It positions itself as a high-quality, sustainable developer with strong urban renewal capabilities and strategic land holdings. Competitors include other major Taiwanese real estate developers focusing on similar market segments and geographic areas.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported annual revenues of approximately NT$6.08 billion in 2024, with a net profit of around NT$205 million, reflecting a decline compared to the previous year. Total assets exceed NT$22 billion, with equity around NT$10.2 billion. The company maintains steady growth with ongoing land acquisitions and project developments, despite market challenges such as credit tightening and economic uncertainties.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself through its commitment to sustainable and smart building practices, integrating green technologies and LEED certification standards. It offers diversified products tailored to market demands, including urban renewal housing and intelligent industrial office spaces. Customer service is enhanced by transparent construction progress reporting, lifelong home inspection services, and digital community management platforms, fostering trust and long-term customer relationships.
